# Debrief: Istio, Envoy

These clips cover Istio's evolution from Envoy sidecars to ambient mode, plus practical Envoy migration lessons, extensibility options, and operational trade-offs relevant to an Istio and Envoy stack. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s); [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s); [Envoy in the Era of Agentic Workloads · 19:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HvX4nGkhfZw&t=1188s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Istio's sidecar-per-pod model proved mesh value but hurt resource use and upgrades, since every pod restart was needed and sidecar versions were hard to see. Ztunnel, a per-node L4 proxy, addressed this. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))
2. One team moving to ambient reported mesh proxy resource allocation falling 40-60% and less version drift across pods. They also hit tooling friction, since Gateway API needs plugins for tools like Argo Rollouts. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
3. Envoy migrations bring behavioral surprises: shared, reused upstream connections added latency for synchronous services, and Envoy Gateway unescaped encoded slashes, causing 404s. Both were fixed through explicit configuration settings. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))

## Action items

- [ ] Review your Envoy upstream connection and circuit breaker settings against your services' concurrency model, checking whether long requests can block short ones on reused connections. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))
- [ ] Check whether any apps depend on encoded path values such as percent-encoded slashes, and test how Envoy path normalization affects them before changing gateways. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))
- [ ] Before evaluating ambient mode, inventory tooling that touches traffic (cert-manager, Argo Rollouts) and check Gateway API plugin or feature support. Compare sidecar proxy resource allocation as a baseline. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s) (1:25), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Explains why sidecars gave way to ztunnel and canary upgrades.
2. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s) (1:23), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Reports measured proxy resource savings and reduced version drift with ambient.
3. [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s) (3:38), Kalen Wessel: Concrete Envoy connection-pooling and path-normalization pitfalls with fixes.
4. [Envoy in the Era of Agentic Workloads · 19:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HvX4nGkhfZw&t=1188s) (1:19), Yan Avlasov, Erica Hughberg: Advice on extending Envoy via dynamic modules or external processing.
5. [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 9:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=599s) (1:20), Mitch Connors, Daniel Grimm: Shows Envoy external processing powering LLM endpoint-picker routing at ingress.
